Content: WebSocket khác HTTP ở communication pattern nào?
Explanation: HTTP: request-response (client initiate, half-duplex). WebSocket: full-duplex bidirectional (cả client và server gửi data bất kỳ lúc nào) qua persistent connection sau initial HTTP handshake.
Option 1: Client-only push — server không thể gửi data nếu client không request trước
Option 2: Request-response giống HTTP nhưng nhanh hơn — chỉ khác ở transport layer optimization
Option 3: Connectionless giống UDP — mỗi message independent không cần maintain connection
Option 4: Full-duplex bidirectional qua persistent connection — cả client và server gửi data bất kỳ lúc nào

Content: WebSocket connection được thiết lập qua quá trình nào?
Explanation: HTTP Upgrade handshake: client gửi HTTP request với headers Upgrade: websocket, Connection: Upgrade → server respond 101 Switching Protocols → connection upgrade từ HTTP sang WebSocket.
Option 1: Client connect trực tiếp đến WebSocket port — không cần handshake
Option 2: HTTP Upgrade handshake: client request Upgrade: websocket → server 101 Switching Protocols → connection upgrade
Option 3: TCP 3-way handshake trực tiếp — không liên quan HTTP
Option 4: DNS lookup resolve WebSocket server IP → direct socket connection

Content: WebSocket phù hợp cho use case nào hơn REST API?
Explanation: Real-time bidirectional: chat, live notifications, gaming, collaborative editing, stock tickers, IoT sensor data. REST phù hợp cho CRUD, stateless operations, caching.
Option 1: Real-time bidirectional: chat, notifications, gaming, collaborative editing, stock tickers
Option 2: CRUD operations với caching — WebSocket tốt hơn REST cho mọi API use case
Option 3: File upload/download — WebSocket handle large binary data tốt hơn HTTP
Option 4: Batch processing — WebSocket queue tasks hiệu quả hơn message queue

Content: WebSocket message types có những loại nào?
Explanation: Text frames (UTF-8 encoded strings — JSON phổ biến), Binary frames (images, files, protobuf), Control frames (Ping/Pong heartbeat, Close). Client và server trao đổi frames.
Option 1: Chỉ có Binary frames — WebSocket là binary protocol không support text
Option 2: Text frames (JSON strings), Binary frames (images/files), Control frames (Ping/Pong/Close)
Option 3: HTTP-like request/response messages — giống REST nhưng qua persistent connection
Option 4: Chỉ có Text frames — WebSocket chỉ support plain text communication

Content: WebSocket connection lifecycle: các events chính nào?
Explanation: onopen (connection established), onmessage (data received), onerror (error occurred), onclose (connection closed). Client-side API: new WebSocket(url) → attach event handlers.
Option 1: Chỉ có connect và disconnect — không có event-driven API
Option 2: request và response events giống HTTP — WebSocket mirror HTTP lifecycle
Option 3: onstart, onpause, onresume, onstop — giống media player lifecycle
Option 4: onopen, onmessage, onerror, onclose — lifecycle events cho WebSocket connection

Content: Heartbeat (Ping/Pong) trong WebSocket giải quyết vấn đề gì?
Explanation: Detect broken connections (network drop, server crash). Client/Server gửi Ping → nhận Pong → connection alive. Timeout → reconnect. Prevent idle connection timeout bởi proxy/firewall.
Option 1: Compress data trước khi gửi — Ping/Pong negotiate compression algorithm
Option 2: Authenticate connection mỗi 30 giây — re-verify credentials periodically
Option 3: Detect broken connections và prevent idle timeout — Ping/Pong verify connection alive, timeout → reconnect
Option 4: Measure network latency — timing Ping/Pong round trip cho performance monitoring

Content: Scaling WebSocket servers: tại sao khó hơn REST API?
Explanation: WebSocket stateful (persistent connections). REST stateless (any server handle any request). Scale WS: sticky sessions (load balancer route same client to same server) hoặc shared state (Redis pub/sub).
Option 1: Stateful persistent connections → cần sticky sessions hoặc shared state (Redis pub/sub) để scale
Option 2: WebSocket tự scale giống REST — stateless by design không cần special handling
Option 3: WebSocket không thể scale horizontally — chỉ vertical scaling
Option 4: WebSocket giới hạn 1 server — multiple servers không supported by protocol

Content: WebSocket vs Server-Sent Events (SSE): khi nào dùng gì?
Explanation: WebSocket: BIDIRECTIONAL (client↔server). SSE: UNIDIRECTIONAL (server→client only). SSE: simpler, auto-reconnect, HTTP-based (cacheable, no special server). WebSocket: chat, gaming. SSE: notifications, live feeds.
Option 1: WebSocket bidirectional (chat/gaming); SSE unidirectional server→client (notifications/feeds) — SSE simpler
Option 2: WebSocket unidirectional; SSE bidirectional — direction ngược với thực tế
Option 3: WebSocket và SSE đều bidirectional — chỉ khác ở browser support
Option 4: WebSocket chỉ cho mobile; SSE chỉ cho web — phân chia theo platform

Content: WebSocket security concerns: ngoài wss:// cần bảo vệ gì?
Explanation: Origin validation (prevent cross-site WebSocket hijacking), authentication (token in initial handshake), rate limiting messages, input validation/sanitization, connection limits per client.
Option 1: Chỉ cần CORS headers — WebSocket dùng cùng security model với REST
Option 2: Origin validation, auth token in handshake, rate limiting, input sanitization, connection limits per client
Option 3: Firewall rules — block WebSocket ports đủ bảo vệ
Option 4: wss:// đủ bảo mật — encryption giải quyết mọi security concerns
